purpose: Does the graph route need a semantic entry point, or does its existing lexical full-text fallback suffice? Each problem class appears TWICE: once phrased in the graph's own vocabulary, once paraphrased so that no distinctive content word is shared with the stored label or description. Passing the lexical variant and failing the paraphrase is the signal that embeddings would earn their place; passing both means they would not.

questions.question: Which algorithms solve symmetric positive definite linear systems Ax=b?
questions.criterion: Names at least one algorithm MaRDI links to the SPD linear systems problem class, such as Cholesky factorization.
